title: ArcOrigin stable tack order-value assessment 2026-10-23
assumptions: Verified source baseline captured 2026-10-23: ArcOrigin 0.1.57 at f111396. The active classic plugin reports version 0.1.57; its active commit hash was not checked. The active classic policy file plugins/ARC/modules/origin-side-job-rewards.yml has SHA-256 51473a9539fcd0aeb7cf8e3109ad756c6396b8a361ab6e65faadb99c893aae87, reward-per-order=20 Vault and daily-order-limit=100 orders per UUID per UTC date.

The complete accepted order remains worth 20 Vault; the shared limit remains 100 orders per UUID per UTC date, or at most 2,000 Vault per UUID-day. All new tack actions and borrowed-tool returns are within one existing whole MOUNTYARD order. No action earns a separate credit. Reward, rate, quota, settlement, and multipliers do not change.

Before/after low/base/high inputs are total accepted side-job orders per UUID-day across the shared quota, not tack-only volume or measured cadence: 10/40/100 orders and 5/20/50 participants. These are scenario sensitivities, not telemetry. There is no network weekly cap.

No tokens, XP, EliteMobs crystals, or permanent gear are awarded before or after. Borrowed tools are returned within the same order. The expanded MOUNTYARD prep/lesson action sequence is defined, with a scoped 480-second order deadline (2x the unchanged 240-second base); all other orders remain at 240 seconds. The unchanged 600-second shift admission window plus 120-second grace gives a 720-second hard stop, and clicks never extend either deadline. Actual native-client completion duration remains unmeasured. No timing, throughput, disposable-income, or hourly-earnings forecast is made.

Fresh read-only classic ledger covers the exact 168-hour window 2026-10-16T00:04:21.585Z (epoch ms 1792109061585) through 2026-10-23T00:04:21.585Z (epoch ms 1792713861585): 3,393 records, 34,013 operations, 28 players. Vault and tokens remain separate currencies.

The ledger reports 67,917,586.30477443 Vault minted and 2,581,843.3499999987 Vault burned; tokens minted 59 and burned 15. AdminVault 67,000,000 from one player is excluded from ordinary income. Unclassified activity totals 134 operations: 131 Vault operations with 189,691.78 absolute Vault amount and 3 token operations with 15 absolute tokens. Currency amounts remain separate.

The jobsRewards breakdown identifies ArcEcoJobs only and does not identify ArcOrigin order cadence. Current SELL shop income is 55,995.33 Vault as a separate unchanged flow; the planned SELL-to-contract transition remains future and unchanged. Neither is used to infer tack-order cadence.

flows.basis: Unchanged 20 Vault per accepted whole order and shared 100-order per UUID per UTC-day cap. Tack actions and borrowed-tool returns are included in one existing MOUNTYARD order and grant no separate credit. Scenario counts are total shared side-job orders, not measured cadence.
No token award before or after; tokens remain a separate unit.
